messages:
Jess: FYI — ACME (prod) hit a 403 on the project console after the org migration last night. They can still call the API (keys/embeddings requests succeed) but the console shows "permission denied" when viewing project settings. Root user was Owner in the org. Repro steps below.

Jess: Repro steps: 1) Login to console as alice@acme.com (Owner). 2) Go to Org > acme-prod > Projects > acme-payments. 3) Click Settings -> 403 modal "You do not have permission to view this project.". API token test: OK.

Support-bot: Ticket SUP-59021 created and assigned to Alex, severity P1.

Alex: Thanks @Jess. Can you paste the org_id, affected user email, and a copy of the browser request headers (redact token) for the console fetch that returned 403? Also include the audit-event id if available.

Jess: org_id: org_acme_9f3, user: alice@acme.com. Browser request (redacted):
```
GET /console/api/projects/acme-payments/members HTTP/1.1
Host: console.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Cookie: session=eyJ...redacted
X-Frame-Options: deny
```
No audit-event id in UI. Customer reports they were Owner pre-migration.

Maria: I'm seeing a pattern — the staged migration rollback job flipped some role_bindings to inactive when org had >500 projects. The job treats inherited=true bindings incorrectly and writes inactive=true. Running a quick audit query now for org_acme_9f3: `SELECT id, principal, role, inherited, active FROM role_bindings WHERE org_id='org_acme_9f3' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;`

Alex: I repro'ed the same locally in staging by toggling the staged_rollback flag. Workaround: re-activate the binding. Example CLI to fix: `rw admin role-binding update --id rb_12345 --active true` or via Console: Org -> Members -> Re-add user to project. I'm going to re-enable the Owner binding for alice@acme.com now and monitor.

Alex: Quick note of the fix I applied: updated rb_98765 (owner binding) -> active=true. Also re-ran cache invalidation for console auth cache: `POST /internal/cache/invalidate?key=auth:org_acme_9f3`.

Jess: Customer confirmed they can access the project console now — no more 403. :white_check_mark:

Infra-oncall: Creating a follow-up: will add a guard to the migration script so it won't flip inherited bindings. Proposed mitigation: set runtime flag `org.migration.disable_staged_rollback` until patch ships. Also schedule a db job to scan orgs for inactive inherited bindings and auto-fix.

Maria: Root cause: staged rollback routine incorrectly toggled `active` for inherited role_bindings for large orgs. Patch in review (cc @eng-iam). We'll include an automated check and a one-off repair for affected orgs.

Support-bot: SUP-59021 updated: priority lowered to P2 after customer confirm. Linked to ENG-1429 (migration rollback bug). Keeping ticket open until patch deploy + postmortem.

Jess: Leaving notes on the ticket: steps taken, rb id updated, cache invalidation command, customer confirmation, and follow-up action items.

Alex: If anyone sees another org with the same symptoms, run the audit query and fix with the CLI command above. I'll ping when the patch is deployed.
